790412501.text: This is it! This is the place we were locked up before...

790410101.text: #Oh, {NICKNAME}, Paimon! I was wondering where you two might be taking a stroll...

790410102.text: Aha, let me see! A melody of pure water sings and twists around you, accompanied by the energy of gracefully dancing dewdrops! You two seem to be in good spirits.

790410103.text: What do you say? Are you interested in sampling more of the delights of the "Veluriyam Mirage"?

790410104.text: Hehe... Even Paimon didn't imagine that Idyia would start speaking more appropriately.

790410105.text: She seems like a different person... Wait! Is she a different person? Are you another creation of Iydia...?

790410106.text: My body has always been my own creation! Alright, that's enough talking about bygone days!

790410107.text: Hey, Idyia seems much more lively. That's so wonderful!

790410108.text: Wait, wait... What were we talking about?

790410109.text: Sampling the delights of the Veluriyam Mirage?

790410112.text: Exactly, great minds think alike! We'll want to explore every nook and cranny of a mysterious place like this!

790410113.text: Chests of hidden Mora — gotta find 'em all!

790410114.text: Aha! I mean truly appreciating this place, not just wandering around it.

790410115.text: Though if it's treasure you're interested in, why not give the "Returning Curios" project a try? It's an old tradition of our newly revitalized Veluriyam Mirage.

790410116.text: Returning... Curiosity? Why hasn't Paimon heard you mention this before?

790410117.text: "Returning Curios," as the name indicates, refers to the multitude of fantastical items that have been swept into the vortex and funneled into the Veluriyam Mirage.

790410118.text: This project goes back many a year. Originally, a veteran adventurer stopped here and was deeply moved by the scenery.

790410119.text: *ahem* It goes without saying that my hospitality helped considerably.

790410120.text: Anyway, he buried his most prized possessions in the place that touched him most deeply. Those were his "Mementos" — three pocket watches made of Mora.

790410121.text: Before leaving, the adventurer left a poetic cipher and asked me to tell it to later guests, to see if they could find it.

790410122.text: Watches made of Mo—Mora? Sounds shiny! And valuable!

790410123.text: I don't know how valuable they are, but when I mentioned it to later guests, they were even more excited than Paimon. They swore to retrieve the treasures left by that adventurer!

790410124.text: Unfortunately, though they searched the whole Veluriyam Mirage, they were still unable to find the treasure trove hidden by the cipher.

790410125.text: But in the process of searching, many guests began to relax and enjoy themselves, and lost all traces of the nervousness they had when they first entered the Mirage.

790410126.text: Though they never found the adventurer's treasure, they found the idea fascinating, and chose to leave behind their own gifts in the Mirage, burying their stories and entrusting me with their care.

790410127.text: In the end, though I never expected this, it has become a sort of tradition here.

790410128.text: This is "Returning Curios" — Deciphering ciphers to reveal the treasures of guests' past! And then, passing down our own stories.

790412602.text: Gah. If only there were some way to see what the order should be...

790410301.text: Back so soon? Such skilled treasure hunters!

790410302.text: Haha, the first cipher was too easy. We knew where to go immediately!

790410303.text: But... what was with the Memento inside the chest?

790410304.text: It seems like... it's from a person who gets hungry easily and stands outside restaurants enticed by the smell of food. The Memento is their snack bag, right?

790410305.text: You're not completely wrong, but not totally right either.

790410306.text: The traveler who left this first chest was a disciplined warrior.

790410307.text: When I saw him in the desert, he was covered in wounds great and small. It was clear he had survived a bitter struggle.

790410308.text: A tired, hungry person would obviously be drawn to the smell of a restaurant! It makes sense such circumstances would inspire written words, even a few lines of poetry.

790410309.text: Whoa! That's actually really different from what we thought...

790410310.text: Why was he fighting in the desert?

790410311.text: If I speak too much, and add my own interpretations, it will color your perceptions and you won't experience their story as they wanted it told.

790410312.text: The Memento still has his notes. Take some time to read them if you're curious.

790410502.text: So, what did you find besides Mora?

790410505.text: Can we open it? But what if there's a creepy doll that pops out? Or fireworks that burst out with a bang!

790410506.text: Oooh, yes, adding surprises to Mementos is a great idea. I'll suggest it to other guests too!

790410507.text: But in this case, this is the standard box that I provide to guests. The guest that left this behind was quite serious, though, so you can rest assured there are no shenanigans!

790410508.text: She was a lost student who woke up one day and found herself in the middle of the desert. She stumbled across the Veluriyam Mirage whilst searching for landmarks.

790410509.text: It seemed like she hadn't finished her schoolwork, so she couldn't stay long. I was flustered too, unable to show her proper hospitality. Even now, I feel guilty about it...

790410510.text: Luckily, her standards were really low! Just sitting in a quiet place stargazing was enough. Her other request was to have a closed, secluded environment to rest in.

790410511.text: So I found a cave for her. Before she left, I even installed a door there that could be closed whenever she wanted undisturbed sleep!

790410512.text: No wonder the cipher mentioned a dreamland. No one would bother you sleeping in a cave like that!

790410513.text: But waking up in a strange place... that sounds familiar.

790410514.text: Maybe as she was sleeping on a carriage, and got thrown off? Perhaps by a grouchy driver?

790410515.text: As Idyia said, Paimon thinks it would be best to wait until we've cleared our heads, then we can try tackling the tale of the mysterious student again!

790410516.text: #There's just one chest left to find now! Come on, {NICKNAME}, let's finish these Returning Curios!

790410517.text: If you really can't wait, go ahead and read it without Paimon! You're a fast reader, it should only take you a moment to read a couple pages.

790410520.text: Let me read it first, then I'll tell you everything.

790410521.text: Alright! With your storytelling, Paimon will be captivated!

790410522.text: Ah! Dividing up the work with just a few words is a testament to your great and practiced teamwork.

790410523.text: So let's continue the Returning Curios, shall we? Listen carefully to the third treasure's cipher...

790410524.text: "A blue, spotless ceiling, a floor of white candy, soft companions surround me, I too have wings!"

790410526.text: Well, it's easy to see, at least. Reaching it however...

790410527.text: This should be fun to watch!

790410852.text: ... and then, ta-da! A Sweet Flower appears! Paimon wonders what kind of expression they'd have.

790411709.text: Water is definitely the foundation of this place. You hit the nail on the head!

790411710.text: #In a meaningful moment such as this, {NICKNAME} is still thinking about such things...! I... I'm truly touched!

790411712.text: Hey! Is it okay to be so casual about it? This is a very important decision, after all!

790411713.text: Hmm... Paimon thinks things like that have definitely happened already. Even without a plan, sometimes you still get a great result...

790411714.text: So that was your plan all along! Paimon totally gets it now.

subQuests.subQuestName: Restore the Hydro Eidolons to their original form

790411901.text: It's finally time! Paimon is getting a bit worked up!

790411902.text: #So, what do you want to leave behind, {NICKNAME}?

790411904.text: Huh? You mean take a picture with the Kamera?

790411905.text: It's just a picture, would anyone really care about that?

790411923.text: A weapon? That's a classic choice!

790411924.text: Weapons in Veluriyam Mirage have a mysterious aura about them... maybe they'll be seen as some kind of legendary weaponry!

790411925.text: But the whole vibe of Returning Curios is really chill and wholesome. Is it okay to leave a weapon behind?

790411951.text: A Sweet Flower? Really? Paimon thought we'd choose something better, something more special.

790411952.text: Imagine for a moment... An adventurer who's been on an incredible journey to the Mirage, finally finding the ultimate treasure of the Returning Curios, left behind by legendary adventurers.

790411953.text: ... and then, ta-da! A Sweet Flower appears! Paimon wonders what kind of expression they'd have.

subQuests.subQuestName: Restore the Hydro Eidolons to their original form

790412401.text: Uh oh, the door's closed. Why did it do that? ... This place is kinda dangerous...

790412402.text: #Let's look around, {NICKNAME}. Maybe we can find some way to open the door!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the location of the hidden treasure

790411201.text: You have already begun your part in the Returning Curios tradition. What's keeping you here? Any questions?

790411202.text: Could you please repeat the cipher?

790411204.text: "A sweet mist permeates all, gazing toward the dancing lamplight, I almost forget to breathe. In the end, memories of childhood guide me, and I take my seat beside the table in peace..."

790411205.text: You shouldn't have a problem remembering it this time! Such a simple riddle should prove no obstacle to you!

790411206.text: We'll be back in a flash!

790411207.text: Such confidence! Looks like you need no encouragement from me.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the location of the hidden treasure

790411301.text: Hmm? Taking your time? It won't be so easy this time, you know!

790411302.text: Could you please repeat the cipher?

790411303.text: Okay, fine! I'll admit, they aren't easy to memorize.

790411304.text: "A shooting star of vines carries me, traversing a forest so quiet and peaceful, to finally arrive in secluded dreamland so pure."

790411307.text: Great! May your treasure hunt be a success!

790411601.text: Someplace high up in the Silver Bottle Courtyard?

790411602.text: A spot up high, huh? Sounds like a plan!

790411603.text: Hiding it up somewhere high is a great choice! The views and experiences along the way will be truly unforgettable.

790411604.text: And of course, mastering the art of scaling difficult terrain is a skill worth learning.

790411605.text: Yeah, we should definitely consider the route. Let's not put it in a spot that's too steep, or else the next guest might not be able to make it up there.

790411608.text: That's a good point! It's like how a big meal tastes better after a hard day of work!

790411609.text: Solving riddles and finding treasures is so satisfying!

790411610.text: Someplace high it is, then. Let's head out!

790411611.text: Hold on, please take this first!

790411612.text: This is a special box imbued with the power of the Hydro Eidolons, which can greatly extend the storage time of Mementos and prevent them from deteriorating over time.

790411613.text: And as for the Memento you choose, you can keep it a secret from me if you want.

790411615.text: With a fantastic container like this, we can store fresh things like fresh fruit and herbs and yummy food for a long time...

790411616.text: But if we don't tell everything to Idyia... Will you still be able to pass along the cipher to other guests?

790411617.text: It's all about mystery and surprise!

790411618.text: Hehe, the treasure you leave behind will become the crown jewel of the Returning Curios project, every bit as impressive as the original Mora Pocketwatch!

790411619.text: I can't wait to see what kind of guest will find your treasure and how they'll react to your Memento...

790411620.text: Will I be able to tell at a glance that this keepsake was left by you?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the decided location to bury the treasure

790411501.text: What is it? Do you need to review the cipher? Though the words are simple, the logic isn't, so it can be hard to remember...

790411502.text: I do indeed need to hear it again.

790411503.text: Do try and remember it this time!

790411504.text: "A blue, spotless ceiling, a floor of white candy, soft companions surround me, I too have wings!"

790411505.text: Go, my friends, with the same happy feelings that the author of the cipher had!

790411506.text: No problem, I've already memorized it!

790411507.text: Of course you did! Looks like I was worried for nothing.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the decided location to bury the treasure

790412101.text: Took you longer this time, huh. Guess you're enjoying solving the riddles!

790412102.text: So, what did you find besides Mora?

790412105.text: Can we open it? But what if there's a creepy doll that pops out? Or fireworks that burst out with a bang!

790412106.text: Oooh, yes, adding surprises to Mementos is a great idea. I'll suggest it to other guests too!

790412107.text: But in this case, this is the standard box that I provide to guests. The guest that left this behind was quite serious, though, so you can rest assured there are no shenanigans!

790412108.text: She was a lost student who woke up one day and found herself in the middle of the desert. She stumbled across the Veluriyam Mirage whilst searching for landmarks.

790412109.text: It seemed like she hadn't finished her schoolwork, so she couldn't stay long. I was flustered too, unable to show her proper hospitality. Even now, I feel guilty about it...

790412110.text: Luckily, her standards were really low! Just sitting in a quiet place stargazing was enough. Her other request was to have a closed, secluded environment to rest in.

790412111.text: So I found a cave for her. Before she left, I even installed a door there that could be closed whenever she wanted undisturbed sleep!

790412112.text: No wonder the cipher mentioned a dreamland. No one would bother you sleeping in a cave like that!

790412113.text: But waking up in a strange place... that sounds familiar.

790412114.text: Maybe as she was sleeping on a carriage, and got thrown off? Perhaps by a grouchy driver?

790412115.text: As Idyia said, Paimon thinks it would be best to wait until we've cleared our heads, then we can try tackling the tale of the mysterious student again!

790412116.text: #There's just one chest left to find now! Come on, {NICKNAME}, let's finish these Returning Curios!

790412117.text: If you really can't wait, go ahead and read it without Paimon! You're a fast reader, it should only take you a moment to read a couple pages.

790412120.text: Let me read it first, then I'll tell you everything.

790412121.text: Alright! With your storytelling, Paimon will be captivated!

790412122.text: Ah! Dividing up the work with just a few words is a testament to your great and practiced teamwork.

790412123.text: So let's continue the Returning Curios, shall we? Listen carefully to the third treasure's cipher...

790412124.text: "A blue, spotless ceiling, a floor of white candy, soft companions surround me, I too have wings!"

790412125.text: *ahem* Something so simple. Anyone would know where to go immediately!

790412126.text: Well, it's easy to see, at least. Reaching it however...

790412127.text: This should be fun to watch!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the decided location to bury the treasure

790412001.text: Yes... Just what kind of keepsake will you leave? Hmm... Will the future me be able to recognize it right away...?

790412002.text: Just follow your hearts, and bury whatever treasure you desire! No hints! I'm looking forward to the surprise!

790412201.text: Ooh, Mondstadt Hash Browns sure are tasty.

790412202.text: Paimon really gets why this Wolfgang adventurer guy misses it!

790412203.text: Such a pity... trapped here, unable to enjoy a Hash Brown one last time...

790412206.text: That's right... Oh! Then that means the island in Mona's dream is also an island from the past!

790412207.text: We can save him if we find where the secret chamber used to be, right?

790412301.text: Ugh, the door closed just like that. Guess this is how that Wolfgang guy got trapped in here...

790412302.text: #Let's look around, {NICKNAME}. Maybe we can find some way to open the door!

790411402.text: We succeeded, big time! All three treasures are ours!

790411403.text: Oh, that fast? I knew you were no ordinary person, but I didn't expect it to be this easy... How was your experience? Special?

790411406.text: Whoever left that third treasure behind is a child at heart! They used creative metaphors, and their clues were right on the money.

790411407.text: Let Paimon guess, are they some kind of fairy tale author or something?

790411408.text: Those aren't metaphors, they're just the real thoughts of a child. The one who left the third treasure behind was actually just a young girl.

790411409.text: Wait, a kid? You're joking, right?

790411410.text: How did she even get up here?

790411412.text: That child overheard her parents talking about a hidden paradise up in the clouds, where all sorts of beautiful creatures like finches and Crystalflies lived. So, she secretly built a big kite, hoping to soar into the clouds and visit her flying friends.

790411413.text: I don't know if it was because the wind was ignorant, or if it was intentional, but the kite ended up being carried off course. Instead of soaring up to the paradise in the sky, it landed in the middle of the desert.

790411414.text: The child didn't find her finches and Crystalflies, but she had a wonderful time playing with the gentle Hydro Eidolons, who became her squishy new friends.

790411415.text: Whoa, slow down there! You talk so fast that Paimon can hardly keep up!

790411416.text: And... for a kid to fly all that way on a giant kite, a lot must have happened along the way. You're going too fast, and it seems like we're missing out on a lot of details.

790411417.text: Look, I really can't explain the sense of wonder that kids feel during their adventures, so you'll just have to experience it for yourselves!

790411418.text: Besides the message from the child, there are also a few pages from her diary in the box, and the details are really something.

790411419.text: But before we get to that, there's still one things left to do that is both full of ceremony, but also quite important. Shall we take care of that first?

790411420.text: Yes, you're right! We've found all the treasures, so now it's time to leave a treasure of our own behind.

790411421.text: #It's finally time! Let's put our heads together, {NICKNAME}. Where would be the perfect spot to bury our treasure?

790411422.text: We have to think this through carefully. We can't be scatterbrained about it!

790412701.text: The door opened! Whew, that was kinda tricky.

790412702.text: #Huh, looks like Wolfgang hasn't written any notes here yet, {NICKNAME}...

790412704.text: We did open the chamber for him back then... This means he won't get stuck now, right?

790412707.text: Wait, then... Um, why don't we leave him a message?

790412708.text: We'll leave it in an obvious place and tell him how to decipher the mechanism!

790412801.text: Let's leave a few words here, he should be able to see 'em!

790412802.text: Let's go back to the island outside the dream, maybe the notes are already gone!

790412902.text: (They describe how one may light the torches up in the right order...)

790413204.text: Paimon guesses some people need some punishment before they'll learn anything...

790413205.text: #These underwater buildings... should be the mountain ruins within the dream... Let's go inside again to make sure, {NICKNAME}.

790413301.text: Well, that door closed, just as expected.

790413302.text: This is the second chamber to trap Wolfgang. Let's see how we can get outta here.

790413401.text: Ahh! The door suddenly closed! Doesn't look like there's a switch, either.

790413402.text: Um, there's no other way out...

790413501.text: Oh, so this is the place...

790413502.text: Isn't this where we got blocked last time, and Wolfgang before us?

790413601.text: Wolfgang's notebook isn't here either. Looks like he hasn't arrived yet.

790413602.text: Let's leave him some hints on how to open this secret chamber again, shall we?

790413605.text: Oh yeah, that's true. If Wolfgang can't make use of the elements...

790413606.text: Then the solution's useless to him. What should we do...

790413701.text: He should have gone into the secret chamber by the time he sees this message. Paimon thinks it won't be of that much use here...

790413801.text: This place should be eye-catching enough!

790413802.text: Let's hope Wolfgang does see it, and doesn't go running around the secret chambers in these ruins anymore...

790413803.text: Let's go back and have a look. Maybe his notes might have changed this time, too!

790413902.text: (They speak of how this place is a perilous secret chamber...)

790414002.text: (They speak of how this place is a perilous secret chamber...)

790414101.text: Well, he didn't go in again. That's a relief.

790414102.text: Still, his annoyingly arrogant attitude is really ticking Paimon off!

790414103.text: He really does sound like he's getting more and more full of himself...

790414104.text: That said, the highland ruins he mentioned should be near the submerged ruins...

790414105.text: Let's take a look. Who knows if he was able to climb so high safely...

790414201.text: (These etchings are old. They have been written as follows...)

790414202.text: "The wind is very strong here, so I'm not going to use a notebook."

790414203.text: "The sunrise here is beautiful indeed. It fills my heart with satisfaction to have braved many dangers to get here."

790414204.text: "I wonder if anyone will come after me to see these same sights."

790414205.text: "Now that I've cleared this particular trial... Next stop, Dragonspine!"

790414206.text: "It's nice here, but it's a crying shame that there's no Mondstadt Hashbrowns..."

790414301.text: Ooh, so there weren't any notes here because he carved a message on the pillar. Huh, so he made it all the way here.

790414302.text: Where does his confidence come from, though... If we hadn't helped him out, he'd still be stuck in the secret chamber!

790414303.text: He's pretty much gonna be Chilled Meat if he goes to Dragonspine!

790414305.text: Eh? U—Um, Paimon just means that he'd be in deep trouble if he went to Dragonspine.

790414308.text: We need to tell him not to go, and quick!

790414309.text: Well, let's leave him another message, shall we...

790414310.text: Right, that's right! Paimon thinks so too... And y'know what, let's leave him some Mondstadt Hash Browns this time!

790414311.text: Maybe he'll start missing the warmth of Mondstadt once he's had a bite, and he'll give up on going to Dragonspine!

790414307.text: Exactly! Dragonspine's super cold and is filled with hilichurls... Not to mention The Great Snowboar King!

790414401.text: Let's leave our message here — and a Mondstadt Hash Brown too!

790414402.text: Paimon really hopes that Wolfgang can give that notion of going to Dragonspine a rest...

790414403.text: Let's go to the ruins we were at before once we leave the dream. Maybe we'll find some sign of him changing his mind!

790414502.text: "Do not go to Dragonspine. It is a perilous place..."

790414602.text: "Do not go to Dragonspine. It is a perilous place..."

790414701.text: (These etchings are old. They have been written as follows...)

790414702.text: "The wind is very strong here, so I'm not going to use a notebook."

790414703.text: "Haha, to think that I'd find a Hash Brown here — and still warm, too! It's practically a miracle."

790414704.text: "Many thanks to whoever etched the messages. Your Hash Brown is the best I've ever tasted."

790414705.text: "And thank you. I do know that Dragonspine is very dangerous... and I know my limits as well. But I must go."

790414706.text: "Who knows, a sign that says 'here be traps' might be the only remnant of my journey to Dragonspine."

790414707.text: "But if someone else can avoid that danger and get further than I did, that to me would be something even more precious than a Hash Brown."

790414708.text: "Thank you, etcher of messages. But we adventurers exist precisely because of perils like Dragonspine."

790414801.text: What the... This guy's saying some pretty glib stuff, huh?

790414802.text: This is bad. We've got to get to Dragonspine and...

790414805.text: Ah... Right, that's true. The entire Golden Apple Archipelago is under the effects of the dream...

790414806.text: That's why Paimon thought that he was rescued... But in the end, he really was just stuck in that secret chamber, wasn't he...

790414807.text: But still, this Wolfgang is really... annoying! We helped him so much, but he still thinks that it would be nice if he could "pave the way" for others...

790414808.text: Couldn't he at least value his life a little more?
